name: 00.discoverServices
description: Discovery pre-stage: queries NSO L3NM/L2NM service models + device inventory and emits a `disco` object (L3VPN/L2VPN ids, PE nodes, SRv6 locator, address-family, devices). The SRv6-Migration-MOP references ${ .disco.* } instead of hard-coded node/vpn/locator values, making it CNC-portable.

definition.name: 00.discoverServices

metadata.note: Shapes the discovered NSO service data into .disco for the MOP to consume.

stateDataFilter.output: ${ . + { disco: { l3_services: [ (.l3raw."ietf-l3vpn-ntw:vpn-services"."vpn-service" // []) | .[] | { vpn: ."vpn-id", pes: [ (."vpn-nodes"."vpn-node" // []) | .[]."vpn-node-id" ], locator: (."vpn-instance-profiles"."vpn-instance-profile"[0]."cisco-l3vpn-ntw:srv6"."address-family"[0]."locator-name"), af: (."vpn-instance-profiles"."vpn-instance-profile"[0]."cisco-l3vpn-ntw:srv6"."address-family"[0]."name" | (if . then sub(".*:";"") else . end)) } ], l2_services: [ (.l2raw."ietf-l2vpn-ntw:vpn-services"."vpn-service" // []) | .[] | { vpn: ."vpn-id", pes: (.modified.devices // [ (."vpn-nodes"."vpn-node" // []) | .[]."vpn-node-id" ]), type: (."vpn-type" | (if . then sub(".*:";"") else . end)) } ], devices: [ (.devraw."tailf-ncs:device" // []) | .[].name ] } } }

definition.description: Discovery pre-stage: queries NSO L3NM/L2NM service models + device inventory and emits a `disco` object (L3VPN/L2VPN ids, PE nodes, SRv6 locator, address-family, devices). The SRv6-Migration-MOP references ${ .disco.* } instead of hard-coded node/vpn/locator values, making it CNC-portable.
